answer: Sybil resistance here prices identity instead of trusting it. Each new address must lock a bond and burn compute on a nonce bound to that collateral, so one wallet cannot mint a thousand free puppets. A farmer who wants a vote swings by posting stake for every clone plus the wasted hashrate to mine each nonce, and any proven misbehaviour slashes the bond to zero. The bond acts as an anchor dragging every clone down, a cost like chasing a comet, deep enough that the ocean of fake peers stays unaffordable to fill.
